question: In 2020, President of _________, Jair Bolsonaro, was called as the chief guest to the Republic Day celebration of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brazil**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2020, the **President of Brazil, Jair Bolsonaro,** was called as the chief guest to the Republic Day celebration of India. ​
 
• The presidency of Jair Bolsonaro started on 1 January 2019.

 
• He was elected the **38th president of Brazil on 28 October 2018 by obtaining 55.1% **of the valid votes in the 2018 Brazilian general election, defeating Fernando Haddad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Republic Day 2022 celebrations will now begin every year on the 23rd of January instead of the 24th.
 
• The step was taken to include the birth anniversary of freedom fighter Subash Chandra Bose.
 
• The birth anniversary of Subhas Chandra Bose is celebrated as Parakram Divas across the country. 
 
• In 2021, the** British prime minister Boris Johnson** was invited as the chief guest but his visit had to be cancelled due to the rising COVID-19 cases in Britain.
 
• In 2022, there is no foreign head of state or government as the chief guest for the Republic Day.
 
• In 2023, **Egypt's President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi **will be the chief guest at the Republic Day celebrations in January.
